text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan got injured during training,
so I brought her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I sincerely apologize for causing you so much concern.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
However, based on my past experience,
an injury of this degree won't be an issue.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Treatment is complete,
so let us resume our training.
choice_data_list: Let's play it safe and rest today.
Got it, just don't overdo it.

text_block_list.text:

so let us resume our training.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...Haste makes waste... is what
you are trying to tell me, correct?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...I understand the gravity of injuries all too well.
Understood. For now,
I shall focus on my recovery.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much for your advice.

With a slightly disappointed remark,
Mejiro Ardan headed back to the dormitory.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
I will keep a very close eye on the state of my injury.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...
...It hurts more than I thought it would...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...It seems I was rushing a bit.
Thinking that I couldn't afford to stop...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Making the injury worse here would be the worst possible move—
I think I really must take some time to rest...

Sounding deeply regretful,
Mejiro Ardan slowly made her way back to the dormitory.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: As long as it's light exercise, there shouldn't be any problem. ...For now, this is enough.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"Above all, I haven't let this injury break my spirit,
so it's okay, fufu."

Mejiro Ardan trained within reasonable limits,
taking her past injuries into careful consideration.
